items.title: Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Stock Looks Like A Bargain After A Sharp Selloff
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan has seen its share price pull back sharply in recent weeks after a strong multi year climb. items.title: Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) Stock Slid, But What Is Drawing Attention Now?
items.summary: Copper's steep one day selloff to a seven month low, driven by a stronger dollar and rate hike expectations, hit Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) hard. The stock slid nearly 7% alongside other major miners. For context, Freeport-McMoRan has seen its share price fall 18.7% over the past week and 28.7% over the past month, with the 90 day share price return down 35.9%.
